sentences.zh: 你现在正在生吃洋葱呢。

sentences.en: No, I mean, people do that all the time.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，人们经常那样做。

sentences.en: Okay, so you cut the lemon open.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以你要把柠檬切开。

sentences.en: And then you like lick it, you squeeze it.
sentences.zh: 然后你就像这样舔它，捏它。

sentences.en: And can you still do that and it doesn't give you the weebie-jeebies?
sentences.zh: 而且你现在还能这样做，而不会觉得浑身起鸡皮疙瘩吗？

sentences.en: I could maybe do that with like a Meyer lemon, but I guess I just loved lemons.
sentences.zh: 我可能对迈耶柠檬做这种事，但我猜我就是超爱柠檬。

sentences.en: Oh, I also remember we had snails and I used to take the snails and like put them on
sentences.zh: 哦，我还记得我们养过蜗牛，我过去常把蜗牛拿来放在

sentences.en: Snails, lemons, and an above ground pool.
sentences.zh: 蜗牛、柠檬，还有一个地上游泳池。

sentences.en: It is time for the office question of the week.
sentences.zh: 又到了每周办公室问答时间。
这是来自安大略省基奇纳的

sentences.en: I am currently listening to the episode Dwight K.
Schrute, acting manager, and I have a question
sentences.zh: 施鲁特，代理经理》那一集，我有一个关于办公室的问题

sentences.en: about the office that I have been dying to ask.
sentences.zh: 憋在心里很久，一直很想问。

sentences.en: Who designed the logo for Dunder Mifflin?
sentences.zh: 邓德米夫林的标志是谁设计的？

sentences.en: It bears a striking resemblance to the logo of the company that my husband works for.
sentences.zh: 它和我丈夫工作的公司的标志惊人地相似。

sentences.en: This company, and by the way, Bonnie, I hope I'm saying this correctly, but Bonnie said
sentences.zh: 这家公司——顺便说一下，邦妮，希望我发音没问题，但邦妮说

sentences.en: the company's name is Malal Blamey Construction, and it was founded in 1982 in Waterloo, Ontario.
sentences.zh: 这家公司的名字叫马拉尔·布莱米建筑公司，它于1982年在安大略省滑铁卢创立。

sentences.en: So it and the logo has been around for longer than the office.
sentences.zh: 所以这个标志存在的时间比《办公室》还要长。

sentences.en: Do a comparison and let me know what you think.
sentences.zh: 做个对比然后告诉我你们怎么看。
让我们来看看这张照片。

sentences.en: And it's kind of got that with white framing.
sentences.zh: 而且有点那种白色边框。

sentences.en: The spacing of the words is close, too.
sentences.zh: 字与字之间的间距也很近。

sentences.en: Like, they're physically very, very close together.
sentences.zh: 就好像，它们实际上靠得非常非常近。

sentences.en: I mean, I see a similarity.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我看到了相似之处。

sentences.en: Bonnie, we will do a side-by-side and put it in our stories, but I do see the similarity
sentences.zh: 邦妮，我们会做一个并排对比图放到我们的动态里，但我确实看到了你所说的

sentences.en: I think it's different enough, but it is similar.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它区别挺明显，但确实很像。

sentences.en: I really liked this question because I realized this is something that we have never dug into.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢这个问题，因为我意识到这是我们从未深入探讨过的事情。

sentences.en: Where did this logo, this very famous logo that is all over the place now on shirts and
sentences.zh: 这个标志——这个现在到处都是、印在衬衫上和

sentences.en: on actual reams of paper, like, who did design this?
sentences.zh: 实际的纸张上的著名标志，究竟是谁设计的？

sentences.en: So I reached out to Greg, and Greg said the original one would have been in the pilot.
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了格雷格，格雷格说最初的那个应该是在试播集里。

sentences.en: Our pilot episode had a different production designer than our longtime production designer,
sentences.zh: 我们的试播集的艺术指导和我们长期合作的艺术指导
迈克尔·加伦伯格不是同一个。

sentences.en: Our DP on the pilot was different from our longtime DP, Randall Einhorn, who took over
sentences.zh: 我们在试播集上的摄影指导和我们长期合作的摄影指导兰德尔·埃因霍恩不同，后者在

sentences.en: once the show got picked up.
sentences.zh: 剧集被预订后接手了工作。

sentences.en: So same with our production designer.
sentences.zh: 我们的制作设计师也是这样。

sentences.en: The production designer on our pilot was Donald Lee Harris.
sentences.zh: 我们试播集的制作设计师是唐纳德·李·哈里斯。

sentences.en: And within his department, Henry Sane was credited as the graphic designer.
sentences.zh: 在他的部门里，亨利·赛恩被署名为平面设计师。

sentences.en: So Greg said his guess is Henry must have designed it.
sentences.zh: 所以格雷格说他猜想这一定是亨利设计的。

sentences.en: And he just remembers that Michael Gallenberg made variations of it for different uses.
sentences.zh: 而且他只记得迈克尔·加伦贝格为了不同的用途制作了它的不同变体。

sentences.en: But Greg said it would be interesting to find out if you can track down either Donald Lee Harris
sentences.zh: 但格雷格说，如果能追踪到唐纳德·李·哈里斯
或者亨利·赛恩并问一下，会很有意思。

sentences.en: Because Greg added that at one point, he was told that the Dunder Mifflin fictional brand
sentences.zh: 因为格雷格补充说，曾有人告诉他，邓德米夫林这个虚构品牌

sentences.en: is the second most famous fictional brand after Duff beer from The Simpsons.
sentences.zh: 是继《辛普森一家》中的达夫啤酒之后第二著名的虚构品牌。

sentences.en: Well, Jenna, this also got me curious about the logo of the BBC version of The Office
sentences.zh: 詹娜，这让我对英国版《办公室》里的公司标志也很好奇
也就是他们的公司沃嫩·霍格。

sentences.en: So I looked it up because I couldn't remember it.
sentences.zh: 所以我查了一下，因为我记不清了。

sentences.en: Me either, now that you mention it.
sentences.zh: 经你这么一说，我也不记得了。

sentences.en: Does it look like the Dunder Mifflin one?
sentences.zh: 它看起来像邓德米夫林的那个吗？

sentences.en: It's red and black and yeah.
It's not framed in any way.
It's got like a big W and then the letters come off that giant W.
sentences.zh: 它有一个大大的W，然后其他字母从那个巨大的W延伸出来。

sentences.en: Well, I found Henry Sane on IMDb.
sentences.zh: 我在IMDb上找到了亨利·赛恩。

sentences.en: He has an extensive resume for graphic design.
sentences.zh: 他有非常丰富的平面设计履历。

sentences.en: I was hoping to see if there was like some trivia about him.
sentences.zh: 我本希望看看有没有关于他的什么趣事。

sentences.en: Like, is there anything attributed to him?
sentences.zh: 比如，有什么作品归功于他吗？

sentences.en: For having designed this very famous logo.
sentences.zh: 关于设计了这个非常著名的标志。

sentences.en: I couldn't find anything, but I did find some contact information for his manager.
sentences.zh: 我什么也没找到，但我确实找到了他经纪人的一些联系方式。

sentences.en: So maybe we can reach out.
sentences.zh: 所以也许我们可以联系一下。

sentences.en: Matt is on vacation this week.
He's high up on a mountain.
So when he's back, maybe we can get to the bottom of it.
sentences.zh: 所以等他回来，也许我们可以查明真相。

sentences.en: And Henry, hey, if you're hearing this, write us.
sentences.zh: 亨利，嘿，如果你听到这个，给我们写信。

sentences.en: Yes, or anyone who knows Henry or anyone who knows who designed this logo.
sentences.zh: 是的，或者任何认识亨利的人，或者任何知道是谁设计了这个标志的人。

sentences.en: We want to hear from you.
Well, this was just a ton of fun.
I had such a great time.
I was so excited today coming into work.
sentences.zh: 我今天来上班时兴奋极了。

sentences.en: Josh was like, what are you so chipper about?
sentences.zh: 乔什问我，你高兴什么呢？

sentences.en: And I was like, well, I don't know.
I just get to go talk with my best friend.
sentences.zh: 我只是去和我的好朋友聊天。

sentences.en: I don't know why I'm saying it like that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我为什么那样说。

sentences.en: I don't either, but I felt the same way.
sentences.zh: 我也不知道，但我有同感。

sentences.en: You know, I'm taking off for my summer vacation after we record this episode.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，录完这期节目后我就要开始暑假了。

sentences.en: So I was sort of aware, like, oh, it's going to be a couple weeks before I get to see you
sentences.zh: 所以我有点意识到，哦，得过好几个星期才能见到你

sentences.en: So this was a nice send off.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一次很好的告别。

sentences.en: Well, I'm doing a little vacay myself, lady.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我自己也要去度个小假，女士。

sentences.en: You're doing a bucket list vacay.
sentences.zh: 你要去完成愿望清单上的旅行。

sentences.en: It is something I've wanted to do, I mean, my whole life, really.
sentences.zh: 这是我一直想做的事，我是说，真的可以说是我的整个一生。

sentences.en: I'm going to Wimbledon, you guys.
sentences.zh: 我要去温布尔登了，各位。

sentences.en: And I'm just giddy about it.
I think I've sent you, like, eight pictures of, like, what do I wear?
sentences.zh: 我想我大概给你发了八张照片，问我该穿什么？

sentences.en: I'm so, so excited for you.
sentences.zh: 我为你感到无比、无比的高兴。

sentences.en: I think we need to do a summer travel journal episode.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们应该做一期夏季旅游日志节目。

sentences.en: I will share about Lake of the Ozarks, and I think you should share about this Wimbledon trip.
sentences.zh: 我会分享关于奥沙克湖的事，我觉得你应该分享这次温布尔登之旅。

sentences.en: Well, on that note, everyone, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 那么，各位，非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: We hope you are also having a great summer, and we will be back next week with another episode.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你们也过了一个愉快的夏天，我们下周会带着另一期节目回归。
